name: glide
description: TRL-based post-training library for LLMs, Speech LLMs, and Vision LLMs. Supports SFT and RL (GRPO, GSPO), autoregressive-decoding evaluation (WER / CER / BLEU / ROUGE), composable YAML configs, and plugins for custom encoders, projectors, rewards, and metrics.

name: asr_with_llm
description: Implementation of SLAM-ASR (Ma et al., 2024), an LLM-based ASR model connecting a Whisper encoder to an LLM through a frame-downsampling MLP projector. Trained on the Corpus of Spontaneous Japanese (CSJ) with Whisper-small and Sarashina2.2-1B, achieving 6.44% CER on eval2.

name: mightning
description: Minimal Lightning-like PyTorch wrapper for single-node multi-GPU training, built on pure DistributedDataParallel, with W&B logging, metric-based checkpointing, and 16-bit mixed precision.
